name: nera-mcp
long_description: Lets Claude create, edit, build, validate, preview and publish websites made with Nera, a static site generator: Markdown pages and Pug layouts, built into plain HTML. Pick the folder your sites live in; Claude works inside it and nowhere else. Node and npm come with the extension, so nothing else needs to be installed.

root.title: Sites folder
root.description: The folder your Nera sites live in. Claude creates new sites in it and may read and change files only inside it.
